title: feat: add MAI batch transcription with fallback
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added microsoft/mai-transcribe-2 to /v1/audio/transcriptions for multilingual file transcription with automatic language detection and timed segments. It has no aliases, accepts Quest or Paid Pollen with a 0.75 multiplier, and is priced per audio hour. Azure is the primary route, with a same-model Vercel Gateway fallback that also ultimately uses Azure; the gateway’s reported cost is preserved, and fallback retains the caller’s discounted quote. Tests cover three response formats, free identical cache hits, disconnect/rejoin, and a single debit and billing event.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, a tiny audio file becomes a timestamped transcript beside two friendly route signs marked Azure and Vercel, with prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow, pastel flowers, and a warm cream background. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny headphones and points at the transcript, small-to-medium sized and sharing the frame without dominating it, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
